title: anthoxanthum odoratum subsp. puelii
intro: Anthoxanthum odoratum subsp. puelii, commonly known as sweet vernal grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family and is native to Europe and Asia. The health benefits of sweet vernal grass include its potential to support respiratory health, particularly in relieving symptoms of asthma and allergies, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce inflammation, making it a potential natural remedy for respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of sweet vernal grass include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects.
